From the surrounding work, I intended it to check the Palace Square/Winter Palace association in note 0. The open failed with `Internal Error` and returned no page body. The same tool call also searched for official St Isaac’s Square context and returned the central-squares route as `turn2search3`.

I omitted the Hermitage PDF attempt from `networkAttemptAccounting` by mistake: I recorded the earlier failed opens and the later successful route page, but missed the open bundled with that search.

Call **245/248** opened the route at a different URL. It was an additional official page after the Hermitage failure, **not** navigation within that failed page. Although the route was discovered in the same bounded search call, it was a separate page open; the attempt record should reflect that.

I made no further changes. The candidate, sourceproof, peer snapshot and captures remain untouched; the coordinator should assess the attempt limit using the preserved native records.
